key: Florinia takes education very seriously!
en: Florinia takes education very seriously!
ja: フロリニアは教育をとても大切にしているんだ!

key: So serious, in fact, you'll have to answer a set of quiz questions to even access her arena!
en: So serious, in fact, you'll have to answer a set of quiz questions to even access her arena!
ja: 本当に真剣で、アリーナに入るだけでも、クイズに答えなきゃいけないくらいなんだよ!

key: Study up, young one!
en: Study up, young one!
ja: しっかり勉強するんだぞ、若いの!

key: Hmm. So you've done your reading after all.
en: Hmm. So you've done your reading after all.
ja: ふむ。ちゃんと勉強してきたようだね。

key: Well, then it's time to put your knowledge to the test.
en: Well, then it's time to put your knowledge to the test.
ja: それなら、その知識を試す時が来たようだ。

key: You earned your Badge from her after all?
en: You earned your Badge from her after all?
ja: 彼女からバッジをちゃんと勝ち取ったのか?

key: She also still has a lot to learn, I suppose.
en: She also still has a lot to learn, I suppose.
ja: 彼女もまだまだ学ぶことが多いんだろうな。

key: I'm afraid Florinia is out on business, and will be for a while.
en: I'm afraid Florinia is out on business, and will be for a while.
ja: 残念だけど、フロリニアは今用事で出かけていて、しばらく戻らないよ。

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ! ジムまで来たみたいだね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムは大ホールに直接つながってるから、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらいに連絡できるんだ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: So you're at Florinia's Gym.
en: So you're at Florinia's Gym.
ja: フロリニアのジムに来てるんだね。

key: Okay! So Florinia's fighting style is a little different from what you might expect from a Grass Leader-- her team is centered around sand.
en: Okay! So Florinia's fighting style is a little different from what you might expect from a Grass Leader-- her team is centered around sand.
ja: よし! フロリニアの戦い方は、くさタイプのリーダーとして想像するのとはちょっと違うんだ――彼女のパーティは砂を中心に組まれてる。

key: Her 'desert rose' fighting style can be tricky-- she'll try to stall you out and take you down with residual sand damage and other status effects.
en: Her 'desert rose' fighting style can be tricky-- she'll try to stall you out and take you down with residual sand damage and other status effects.
ja: 彼女の『砂漠のバラ』戦法は厄介でね――砂の継続ダメージや状態異常でじわじわ削って、粘って倒そうとしてくるんだ。

key: Florinia's all about knowledge and strategy, so try something different from that to beat her.
en: Florinia's all about knowledge and strategy, so try something different from that to beat her.
ja: フロリニアは知識と戦略が信条だから、それとは違うアプローチで倒すといい。

key: Maybe you can find a way to abuse the sand and get lucky? Even if she insists that's not a factor.
en: Maybe you can find a way to abuse the sand and get lucky? Even if she insists that's not a factor.
ja: 砂を逆に利用して運任せに行くのもありかもね? 本人は「運は関係ない」って言い張るだろうけど。

key: Or, pick something that hits hard and power through her before she can get her effects going! Brawn over brains, if you will.
en: Or, pick something that hits hard and power through her before she can get her effects going! Brawn over brains, if you will.
ja: それか、強力な一撃で、効果が発動する前に押し切っちゃうのもいいね! いわば、頭脳より力技ってやつ。

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張ってね!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールの方、誰も出ないみたい……
